findings.finding: All events and identifiers are deterministic synthetic operational course data.
findings.impact: Do not describe counts, delays, conflict shares or department combinations as hospital operating results.

findings.finding: The dataset contains no patient identity, diagnosis, treatment, clinical priority, real bed capacity or physical route data.
findings.impact: The case may coordinate event order and role cosign only; it must not render patient or clinical decisions or a factual hospital map.

findings.finding: Each conflict class has exactly 120 rows by design.
findings.impact: Use the classes as deterministic state-machine fixtures, not as prevalence or performance benchmarks.
